profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. According to its own site, it builds lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and it says its sensors serve as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, supporting features such as automated emergency braking (AEB), navigation on autopilot (NOA), and advanced semi-autonomous driving.

The company states that it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, and that it has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It also says it provides sensors meeting the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at robotaxis, robobuses, trucking, and industrial applications.

The record holds no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company. Its profile lists a SEC Central Index Key of 0001861737, confirming its status as a public filer.
